# Code of Conduct

## Our pledge

Skotiq is a welcoming, harassment-free community for everyone, regardless of
experience level, background, or identity. Contributors and maintainers commit
to interacting in ways that keep participation open, respectful, and
constructive.

## Our standard

This project adopts the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org),
version 2.1. The full text is published at:

https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/

In short: be respectful, assume good faith, give and accept constructive
feedback gracefully, and focus on what is best for the community. Behaviour that
makes others unwelcome or unsafe is not tolerated.

## Scope

This applies within all project spaces — issues, pull requests, discussions, and
any other official channel — and when an individual is representing the project
in public spaces.

## Reporting

If you experience or witness unacceptable behaviour, report it privately to the
maintainer using the contact address on the
[maintainer's GitHub profile](https://github.com/Scdouglas1999). Reports are
handled confidentially. The maintainer will review and respond as promptly as is
reasonable, and will respect the privacy and safety of the reporter.

## Enforcement

Maintainers are responsible for clarifying and enforcing this standard and may
remove, edit, or reject contributions, or restrict participation, for behaviour
they deem inappropriate. Enforcement follows the Contributor Covenant 2.1
enforcement guidelines linked above.
